summary: Tiziana Life Sciences filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing quantitative PET imaging results from the third Multiple System Atrophy patient in a Phase 2 clinical trial of intranasal foralumab. The release reports up to 34% reduction in SUV and 26% reduction in SUVR in affected brain regions, consistent with prior patients. This is a routine clinical development update, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or structural changes are involved. Filers and investors should monitor subsequent trial data and regulatory milestones rather than any transactional event.
